newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Mayor says has not picked new transit head.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Mayor says has not picked new transit head.

text.p: Chicago Mayor Richard Daley said Tuesday he has not yet chosen a new leader for the financially strapped Chicago Transit Authority.

Responding to a report in the Chicago Sun-Times that he had selected Assistant U.S. Transportation Secretary Frank Kruesi to lead the transit authority, Daley told reporters he had not made a decision on that post.
Kruesi, a former Daley aide, is under consideration for the top spot at the transit authority among other candidates. Daley has set no timetable for the appointment.
The transit authority board approved plans earlier in July to cut late night train and bus service and eliminate some bus routes to save about $25 million per year.
Even with the cuts, the transit authority projects continuing deficits without further cuts or more federal funding.
